label: Manifesto de Marca (45s) · A Cicatriz Dourada (Kintsugi & Resiliência)
description: Manifesto filosófico sobre superação e resiliência em 16:9: cerâmica antiga quebrada sendo reconstruída pacientemente com laca natural de urushi e pó de ouro puro 24k, transformando a fratura na parte mais bela da obra.
resources: sound design tátil de cerâmica e ouro

scenes.prompt: Philosophical craft brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. A shattered dark tenmoku tea bowl lies in clean broken ceramic shards on a dark tatami mat under a focused soft beam of morning light. High contrast, 35mm film texture. Non-verbal sound design: delicate porcelain fracture sound decaying into quiet morning stillness. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A FRATURA INEVITÁVEL.

Philosophical craft brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Macro shot of a master's hands carefully aligning the ceramic fragments, joining them with a fine line of natural dark urushi tree resin. Extreme patience and steady precision. Non-verbal sound design: soft tactile ceramic contact click and steady breathing. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A RECONSTRUÇÃO PACIENTE.

Philosophical craft brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Macro shot of a fine bamboo brush dusting brilliant 24-karat pure gold powder along the still-tacky resin seam. The fracture line instantly catches light and ignites with brilliant golden luminescence. Non-verbal sound design: delicate dry whisper of brush dusting gold powder, gentle warm sine swell. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O VALOR DA CICATRIZ.

Philosophical craft brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. The fully restored kintsugi bowl is held in both hands, illuminated by a warm golden sunbeam. The glowing gold veins tell a story of resilience that makes the object infinitely more beautiful than when it was unbroken. Non-verbal sound design: warm emotive cello melody and resonant singing bowl chime. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: MAIS FORTE QUE ANTES.

Philosophical craft brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Hero brand lockup: glowing golden calligraphy and crisp modern typography emerge against a dark textured stone background. Pure emotional and aesthetic elevation. Non-verbal sound design: acoustic grand piano chord resolving into serene silence. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A BELEZA DA SUPERAÇÃO.

narration.text: As quedas e as fraturas não diminuem o seu valor. Quando você reconstrói com coragem e verdade, suas cicatrizes deixam de ser marcas de dor e se tornam a sua maior fonte de luz.
narration.voice: voz feminina brasileira madura, calorosa, serena, profunda, poética e acolhedora, tom de sabedoria ancestral e resiliência

blocks.text: A vida quebra aquilo que parecia inquebrável.
Mas a resposta não é esconder a queda.
É unir cada pedaço com o ouro da experiência.
O que foi reconstruído se torna infinitamente mais forte.
A beleza da superação. Honre a sua história.

audio.musicIntent: Intimate East-meets-West neoclassical score with delicate koto, emotional solo cello, warm felt piano and a serene, uplifting resolution.
